plotEn:
Henry "Fitz" Fitzgerald is a former United States Army Special Forces (Green Beret) soldier who lives off the grid in Wyoming designing weapons for a U.S. military research projects agency.
Meanwhile, a ruthless Middle Eastern corporation, Brownstone, uses aggressive machinations to force people out of their homes and steal their lands for the company. Two hunters attempt to kill Jack Hernandez, a young boy who is the son of Fitz's deceased military friend, but Fitz shoots a warning arrow into their rifle stock and both are forced to back away. 
Fitz and Jack go hunting but Fitz refrains from killing an elk after seeing it has a family. Soon after Fitz tells Jack to go home, he sees that Headwaters, his base, is under threat from Brownstone mercenaries, led by Graves and his henchman, McNeil. The mercenaries beat and stab Fitz with his own knife and throw him in the river, but he manages to survive, make it back to Headwaters and treat his wounds. Fitz then assaults and tortures the same mercenary who stabbed him into telling him what Graves is up to next and then shoots him dead as retaliation for stabbing him.
Graves, McNeil and the Brownstone mercenaries attack the Hernandez family home and burn it to the ground, and Jack's grandfather, Javier, is shot. Fitz sneaks onto the farm land and kills five of the mercenaries, rescuing Jack, Javier and Jack’s mother, Sophia, who kills the last mercenary as Graves and McNeil escape.
